delivery.a: Chișinău — next working day. Across Moldova — 1 to 3 working days with the courier. Free over 2,000 MDL.

cod.a: Yes. Cash or card to the courier on delivery, or a bank transfer for companies.

test.q: Can I test a board before buying?
test.a: Yes — book a slot at the showroom or join a demo day on Lake Ghidighici from May to September.

returns.q: What if the board does not suit me?
returns.a: 14 days to return unused gear in its original packaging. Warranty claims are handled locally, no shipping abroad.
